Data Analyst

Globex is looking for a Data Analyst to join our growth team. You will build dashboards, write SQL against our warehouse, and partner with product managers to define metrics.

Requirements: 2+ years of analytics experience, strong SQL, experience with Looker or Tableau, and comfort with Python for ad-hoc analysis. Familiarity with dbt is a plus. You should be able to communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

We offer a hybrid schedule from our Springfield office and competitive benefits.
